purpose: Owner-cited sources (15-10-2026) for three La Cruz (Tumbes) names, retrieved on the GitHub runner, archived with SHA-256 and quote-tested. Identity, works and event evidence are recorded separately; geometry and outlet stay UNKNOWN.
correction: Supersedes the 15-10 executive report statement that no official source named Banchero, Banchero Rossi or Mariátegui as quebradas: that search had not read INDECI RC 1951 (2024), the MVCS 2021 note or MD La Cruz R.A. 128-2023. PR #378's verdict NOT_A_QUEBRADA_IN_SOURCES_READ remains correct for the sources it read (INDECI RC 3755-2025 lists 'Banchero Rossi' among cleaned streets; ANA 2016 Piura names the settlement 'AH José Carlos Mariátegui').
